guard: a family membership row (#5404) is keyed with its > stored as =, so no grant or purge built from the key is a wildcard; only a whole last = segment decodes back; memberKey refuses every other pattern; the family grammar refuses the root > and any *; and listMembers(covering) returns a channel's own rows plus the families above it and nothing else
why: The suite imports the registry helpers from ../src/index.js and starts a plain JetStream broker, so a mutation of subjects.ts or members.ts is what the run sees; no build is needed.
members.smoke.ts stops at the first failed assertion, and each mutation below breaks one family cell that runs before any later cell could fail for another reason.
No completionMarker: the suite stops at its first failed assertion by design, so a killed mutant never prints the closing banner. The named red is the cell's own assertion message.

mutations.name: a family key keeps its raw > (a wildcard in every grant and purge built from it)
memberKey accepts any pattern, not only a family
mutations.expectRed: memberKey refuses a pattern that is not a family and a channel spelled with =
mutations.cell: memberKey refuses a pattern that is not a family and a channel spelled with =

mutations.name: parseMemberKey decodes an = anywhere in the channel
mutations.expectRed: parseMemberKey refuses an = that is not a whole last channel segment
mutations.cell: parseMemberKey refuses an = that is not a whole last channel segment

mutations.name: the family grammar admits a * segment
mutations.expectRed: the root >, any *, a bare channel, team.** and a mid > are not families
mutations.cell: the root >, any *, a bare channel, team.** and a mid > are not families

mutations.name: familiesCovering also lists a family under the channel itself
covering admits every family row, not only those above the channel
mutations.expectRed: listMembers(covering=team.backend) = its own row and team.>, not team.backend.> or teams.>
mutations.cell: listMembers(covering=team.backend) = its own row and team.>, not team.backend.> or teams.>
